## Change

Describe the problem and proposed behavior. Link a public ASIP for substantive changes.

## Status and evidence

Identify proposed requirements, informative text, and any implementation results separately.

## Review

- [ ] Compatibility, security/privacy, and failure behavior addressed.
- [ ] Scenarios and changelog updated where applicable.
- [ ] Repository check and whitespace check pass.
- [ ] Synthetic/public-safe contents only; no private context or personal data.
- [ ] Contribution rights and repository license reviewed.
